one_liner: Error tracking and application monitoring platform to discover, triage, and diagnose errors.
auth_notes: Supports OAuth2 and static Auth Tokens passed via Bearer authorization headers.
access_notes: Sentry has a free Developer plan and free trials available upon sign-up.
api_notes: Covers organizations, teams, projects, issues, events, releases, crons, dashboards, and more via REST API (v0).
blocker_notes: Public APIs and official MCP are fully accessible via self-serve accounts.

access.quote: Sentry has one free Developer plan and three paid plans: Team, Business, and Enterprise.

api.quote: The Sentry web API is used to access the Sentry platform programmatically. You can use the APIs to manage account-level resources, like organizations and teams, as well as manage and export data.

mcp.quote: Yes, Sentry has an MCP Server (...and it’s pretty good)

verdict.quote: The current version of the Sentry's web API is considered v0. Our public endpoints are generally stable, but beta endpoints are subject to change.
